# Contributing to BBXDOO

Thank you for your interest in contributing to BBXDOO! This document provides guidelines to help you get started.

## How to Contribute

### Reporting Issues

- Search existing issues before opening a new one.
- Use the provided issue templates where available.
- Include as much detail as possible: steps to reproduce, expected behavior, and actual behavior.

### Proposing Changes

1. Fork the repository and create a new branch from `refactor/v0.2`.
2. Make your changes, following the existing code style and structure.
3. Ensure your changes do not break existing functionality.
4. Update relevant documentation if needed.
5. Open a Pull Request using the provided PR template.

### Pull Request Guidelines

- Keep PRs focused and minimal — one concern per PR.
- Reference related issues in the PR description.
- All changes must pass review before merging.
- Governance or policy changes require sign-off per the governance rules described in `governance/`.

## Collaboration Policy

All contributions — including those assisted by AI tools — must follow the guidelines in [`docs/collaboration/COLLABORATION_POLICY.md`](../docs/collaboration/COLLABORATION_POLICY.md).

## Code of Conduct

By participating in this project, you agree to abide by the [Code of Conduct](.github/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md).

## Questions?

See [SUPPORT.md](SUPPORT.md) for how to get help.
